strings.onb.welcome.title: Welcome to PranaDin
strings.onb.welcome.body: A few minutes each day for breath, stillness and reflection, alongside the festivals and sacred days of many traditions.
strings.onb.welcome.point1: No account needed. Your practice and journal stay on this phone.
strings.onb.welcome.point2: Free during the beta, with no ads.
strings.onb.welcome.point3: We list our sources, and a person checks every Hindi and Marathi text before it appears.
strings.onb.safety.title: Before you begin
strings.onb.safety.body: PranaDin shares gentle breathing and meditation practices, and information about traditions and festivals. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, therapist or your own teacher.
strings.onb.safety.point1: Go gently. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness, breathlessness or distress.
strings.onb.safety.point2: Check with a doctor first if you are pregnant, or have heart disease, high or low blood pressure, glaucoma, epilepsy, a recent surgery or injury, or a mental-health condition.
strings.onb.safety.point3: In an emergency, call 112. For mental-health support, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (toll-free).
strings.onb.goal.title: What would you like help with?
strings.onb.goal.hint: Pick one. You can change it later.
strings.goal.calm.desc: Slow, steady breathing and a short sit
strings.goal.sleep.desc: Long, easy exhales and a body scan in the evening
strings.goal.focus.desc: Even breathing and counting to steady attention
strings.goal.devotion.desc: Humming breath and silent repetition of a word or name you hold dear
strings.onb.time.title: How much time do you have each day?
strings.onb.time.hint: Even 5 minutes is a good start.
strings.onb.when.title: When would you like to practise?
strings.onb.city.title: Your city
strings.onb.city.body: We use it only to show sunrise, sunset and the day's tithi. It stays on this phone.
strings.onb.city.locationHelp: Your phone will ask for permission. We only look for the nearest city.
strings.onb.city.locationDenied: Location is off. Search for your city instead.
strings.onb.city.noResults: No city called "{query}". Try a larger city nearby.
strings.onb.city.defaultNote: If you skip, we use New Delhi. You can change it later.
strings.today.plan.title: Today's practice
strings.today.plan.allDoneSub: Come back tomorrow, even for two minutes.
strings.today.welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
strings.today.welcomeBack.body: Begin again with 3 minutes. Your past days still count.
strings.today.panchang.setCity: Set your city for local sunrise and tithi.
strings.today.panchang.howBody: We calculate tithi, nakshatra, sunrise and sunset on your phone for the city you choose. The tithi shown is the one at local sunrise, as many traditional panchangs do. Your temple or printed panchang may differ by region or tradition; where they differ, follow your own tradition.

strings.safety.title: Practise safely
strings.safety.caution: Go gently and stop if you feel dizzy, breathless or unwell. None of these practices ask you to hold your breath. If you are pregnant, or have a heart, lung or blood-pressure condition, check with your doctor before you start. This is a wellbeing practice, not medical treatment.
strings.safety.short: Stop if you feel dizzy or unwell.

strings.breath.outRight: Breathe out through the right nostril

strings.privacy.title: Privacy and your data
strings.privacy.summary: Your practice history, streak and journal are stored only on this phone. We can't see them or recover them.
strings.privacy.clear.title: Clear all your data?
strings.privacy.clear.body: This deletes your journal, streak, practice history and settings from this phone. It can't be undone. Download your journal first if you want to keep it.
strings.privacy.cleared: All data cleared. PranaDin will start fresh.
strings.help.title: Help and safety
strings.help.notMedical: PranaDin is not medical advice. If something feels wrong, stop and rest.
strings.help.whenToStopBody: Stop and breathe normally if you feel dizzy, light-headed, breathless, in pain or anxious. Sit or lie down until it passes. If it doesn't pass, get medical help.
strings.help.emergencyBody: Call 112 for emergency services anywhere in India. Outside India, call your local emergency number.
strings.help.mentalBody: Tele-MANAS is the Government of India's toll-free mental-health helpline, available in many languages. Call 14416 or 1-800-891-4416.
strings.feedback.title: Send feedback
strings.feedback.label: What would you like to tell us?
strings.feedback.helper: Up to 500 characters. Please don't include private details.
strings.feedback.emailHelper: Only if you'd like a reply.
strings.feedback.sent: Thank you. Your message has been sent.
strings.feedback.failed: Your message didn't send. Check your connection and try again.
strings.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.error.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
strings.error.storage: This browser is blocking storage, so we can't save your progress. Turn off private browsing or allow site data, then reload.
strings.error.storageFull: Your phone is low on space, so we couldn't save. Free up some space and try again.
strings.error.location: We couldn't find your location. Search for your city instead.
strings.error.audio: Sound couldn't start. Tap Start again, or continue in silence.
strings.error.share: Sharing isn't available here, so we copied the text for you to paste.

strings.yoga.level.label: Level
strings.yoga.safety.title: Before you begin
strings.yoga.safety.1: Go within your comfort. If you feel pain, dizziness or strain, stop and rest.
strings.yoga.safety.2: This is not medical advice. If you have an injury or a health condition, or are pregnant, see your local health professional before you start.
strings.yoga.safety.3: Keep your breath smooth and easy in every pose. Never strain it.
strings.yoga.safety.4: Warm up first, move slowly and skip any pose that does not feel right today.
strings.yoga.safety.short: Stop if you feel pain or dizziness.
